copy.description: Tired of your pet claiming the warmest spot in the house? This summer sleeping mat gives your cat or dog a spot of their own. The maker lists it as self-cooling but gives no cooling temperature. It is a sleeping pad made of cloth, with a waterproof finish, so wet paws and small spills are easier to clean up. It is made for both cats and dogs, which makes it a practical pick for a home with more than one kind of pet. Set it where your pet already likes to lie, and see whether they settle in. It is a simple, no-fuss addition to the spots you already use. This page does not list exact dimensions or a cooling temperature, so measure your space before you order.

faq.a: It is sold in size XS in four colors (blue, coffee, grey, pink). The maker does not list exact dimensions, so it suits small pets and small spaces best.
It is made of cloth. It is listed as waterproof and self-cooling, but no cooling temperature is listed.
